site_name: 78 Alexandra Road, Wood Green, London, N8 0LJ
description:
The proposal seeks planning permission for the erection of a single-storey rear extension to the existing rear wraparound extension at the property. The extension would project approximately 2 metres beyond the existing rear wall, span the width of the existing extension, and be set back approximately 1 metre from the side boundary to retain the garden walkway.

The extension would have a flat roof incorporating a flush rooflight to improve natural daylight to the enlarged internal space. External materials would be selected to match or complement the existing dwelling. No alterations are proposed to the front elevation or upper floors.

The works would enlarge the existing communal living/dining area. There is no change of use proposed, and the property will continue to operate within its lawful Use Class C4 as a small House in Multiple Occupation for up to six residents.
